failure_modes: Saving money on the decision-making step
gloss: Prefer strong agents in a simple topology; use cheap agents only where errors are cheap
invariants: Errors that redirect the whole swarm are priced in
Cheap agents work below a capable coordinator
mechanism: Two schools exist: many cheap agents with large compute, or the best available agents. A few percent more capability removes a mistake that would send a whole swarm the wrong way. Applying {{mix}} keeps cheap sub-agents for volume work under the {{topology}} of a coordinator and lanes. Cost comparisons should use what an employee costs a business, not a hobbyist's budget.
